statement: WTI front-month crude futures settle at or above 95.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: TRUE if any front-month WTI daily settlement reported by CME or major financial press between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-14 is 95.00 USD or higher; else FALSE.

statement: The 30-year US Treasury yield closes at or above 6.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the daily closing 30-year Treasury yield reported by the US Treasury or major financial press reaches 6.00 percent or higher on any trading day in the window; else FALSE.

statement: The S&P 500 index closes below 7000 on at least one trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the official S&P 500 closing level reported by major financial press is below 7000 on any trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-30; else FALSE.

statement: The United States and Iran publicly announce a ceasefire or formal cessation of hostilities between 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if both governments, or a joint statement, publicly confirm a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities reported by major press between 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-30; else FALSE.

statement: A United States government official publicly confirms or denies the reported rejected Iran ceasefire proposal between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-03.
resolution: TRUE if a named US official or spokesperson, in on-record public reporting between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-03, confirms or denies the reported ceasefire proposal; else FALSE.

statement: The CDC publicly identifies a specific implicated food product or source for the US cyclosporiasis outbreak between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: TRUE if a CDC advisory or public statement between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31 names a specific food product or source linked to the outbreak; else FALSE.

statement: The government of France declares a national state of emergency or equivalent nationwide wildfire emergency between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-07.
resolution: TRUE if the French national government formally declares a nationwide state of emergency for the wildfires, reported by major press between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-07; else FALSE.

statement: CISA adds the Certighost Active Directory vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: TRUE if a Certighost-related CVE appears in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-15; else FALSE.

statement: The US cyclosporiasis case count reported by the CDC exceeds 15000 between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: TRUE if a CDC report or advisory between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31 states a case count above 15000 for the cyclosporiasis outbreak; else FALSE.
